profile_text.body:
Allient Inc is a public company headquartered in Williamsville, New York, and trades under the ticker ALNT. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000046129. The website associated with the company is alantra.com.

The text harvested from that site describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. According to that text, it provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and operates under a listed partnership model in which teams work within corporate governance structures while retaining autonomy.

The held record contains no tracked products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for this company. Its law exposure is recorded against New York, with a count of 459.
